questions.question: What is the mass of the new vector boson?
questions.reason: 10 MeV is a common light-mediator benchmark (conventions section 11); the description says only 'light' and gives no mass.

questions.question: What is the coupling g_nu of the vector boson to the left-handed neutrino current, in the normalization L = g_nu Z'_mu nubar gamma^mu P_L nu?
questions.reason: 1e-4 is a conventional light-mediator coupling benchmark (conventions section 11); the description gives no coupling value.

questions.question: Which neutrino flavors does the boson couple to, with the same strength for each, and are there any flavor off-diagonal couplings (give ee, mm, tt, em, et, mt as multiples of g_nu)?
What is the vector coupling g_u of the boson to the up quark (the average of its left- and right-handed chiral couplings)?
What is the vector coupling g_d of the boson to the down quark (the average of its left- and right-handed chiral couplings)?
